title.zh: 废止第920号共和国法第一编C部分（a）目第34项（e），并将其中所定45000比索用于高山省Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk公路建设的法案
title.en: An Act Repealing Item Thirty-Four (e), Subsection (a), Title C of Section One of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty, and Appropriating the Amount of Forty-Five Thousand Pesos Therein Provided for the Construction of the Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk Road in Mountain Province
title.orig: An Act Repealing Item Thirty-Four (e), Subsection (a), Title C of Section One of Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty, and Appropriating the Amount of Forty-Five Thousand Pesos Therein Provided for the Construction of the Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk Road in Mountain Province

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1213_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Item thirty-four (e), subsection (a), Title C of section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty, on page one hundred and fourteen thereof, is hereby repealed, and the sum of forty-five thousand pesos therein provided is hereby appropriated for the construction of the Calanan-Tuga-Pinukpuk Road in Mountain Province.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 10, 1955.
